note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because the two payload kinds disagree on shape: the 316 `meta.kind=episode` records carry five top-level structs (`lie`, `red_herring`, `diagnosis`, `recovery`, `verification`) that the 2552 `meta.kind=designed` records omit, and `meta` / `reward` / `tool_call.args` are key-bags whose keys differ per record, so the datasets-server infers a schema from an early shard and then cannot cast a later one. Declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record. Counts on this card were re-derived from the 2869 records in the published `batch-r01.jsonl` through `batch-r1435.jsonl`; they replace the earlier 1749-record `r01`-`r875` audit.

features.note: present on all 2869 records and always a string

features.name: goal
features.note: present on all 2869 records and always a string

features.name: plan
features.note: present on all 2869 records and always a string; it is not optional in this dataset

features.name: lie
features.note: present on 316 of 2869 records (every `meta.kind=episode` record, no `designed` record); always the same two string keys, so it is declared as a struct rather than json and stays searchable

struct.name: dismissed_at_step
struct.note: present on 315 of the 316 records that carry `red_herring`; absent on `obs-r22-ms-recorded-as-seconds-histogram`

features.name: diagnosis
features.note: present on 316 of 2869 records (episode only); uniform int + string keys

features.name: recovery
features.note: present on 316 of 2869 records (episode only); uniform int + string keys

features.name: verification
features.note: present on 316 of 2869 records (episode only); uniform int + string keys

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool (`command`, `path`, `old`, `new`, `contents`, `old_string`, `new_string`, `pattern`, `glob`)

features.name: outcome
features.note: present on all 2869 records and always a string

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: 269 distinct keys across 2869 records. `success` (bool) on every record; `plan_changes`, `cost_steps`, `handoff` on all 2552 designed records; `steps`, `red_herring_dismissed` on all 316 episode records; `xfailed` on 1276 designed records; `terminal_only`, `horizon_steps`, `mid_reward_steps` on the one dest-stamped `srl-*` record; the remaining ~200 keys are per-episode measurements, and `panel_before`, `child_s`, `edges` are int on some records and float on others

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `round` (int), `generator` on every record; `kind` on 2868; `service`, `dashboard`, `lie` (a string, unrelated to the top-level `lie` struct) on the 2552 designed records; `seed`, `designed` (bool) on the 316 episode records; `plant` on the one dest-stamped `srl-*` record

disclosures.summary: One record in `batch-r500.jsonl` is a dest-stamped leftover-mill row: it keeps `meta.factory=sparse-reward-long-task-factory`, `meta.plant=designed`, no `meta.kind`, and sparse-reward reward keys (`terminal_only`, `horizon_steps`, `mid_reward_steps`). It is kept exactly as generated. Re-derived independently as 1 of 2869 in the published `r01`-`r1435` payload; already owned by the frozen factory_mix census, so no new leftover census is opened here.

disclosures: The other 2868 records are `observability-debug-factory` leftover-lie (wrong dashboard / dropped label) episodes: 316 carry `meta.kind=episode`, 2552 carry `meta.kind=designed`. The 869 `leftover`-bearing record ids and 314 `leftover`-bearing goals on `obs-*` records are this factory's own advertised leftover-lie mechanic, not a foreign dump.
A full scan of all 1435 shards found no `sir-*` (search-index-rebuild) leftover-in-id record and no dest-stamped payload other than the single `srl-*` row above.
Every record is generated by `grok-4.6` and every one of the 43054 steps publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
